dissent.internal: The runner-up disposition was REJECTED on the grounds that INC-10 (an evidence-identity-family exemplar) now carries a self-referential evidence pointer, which the counter-evidence sweep flags as a form of mis-attribution and which could mildly distort the calibration of the evidence-integrity hard gates. I chose ACCEPTED instead because (a) the defect that actually caused T1R-02's rejection (F9) is cleanly and completely closed and is what this review was convened to adjudicate; (b) every INC-10 assertion verifies TRUE against stable true-sources (runs/T-1 C11 three-domain table, authority_map.change_record, T0R-01) - this is pointer rot, not a false claim, unlike T1R-01's wrong-source findings where claims were unverifiable from the cited sources; (c) the root cause is the closer's external overwrite of the T-1 review (the pre-flagged F10 collision, commit b75a083dc), not the v3 micro-run, and the re-pin was the forced consequence of keeping A-common 33/33 true. Rejecting v3 would debit a closer error to the executor and force a micro-run for an out-of-mandate hygiene nit. Acceptance is therefore conditioned on the closer repairing F12 before hard-gate calibration.
dissent.note_on_scope: This proposal does not assess whether the 16 cases are the right cases to build from, nor the feasibility of the 24/24/24 plan - both are T2 scope and were deliberately not entered. The v1 and v2 run packages were verified retained and unmodified. The overwrite of the T-1 review at reviews/T1R-02/ is attributed to the closer's deposition (b75a083dc), not to the v3 run (whose write boundary is the run directory only).
dissent.severity_note: This acceptance reflects that v3 is materially cleaner than v2: v2 failed A-common on 2/33 declared hashes (a hard-gate violation, record-layer, executor-attributable); v3 passes A-common 33/33 with the residual field removed entirely, and its one reservation (F12) is an externally-caused, factually-true, single-pointer hygiene issue routed to the closer.

accepted_because: T1R-02's sole residual defect F9 is cleanly closed: incidents.jsonl has 0 occurrences of sha256_worktree; every source_ref carries exactly {path, exists, tracked, sha256_canonical, sha256_canonical_domain}; 33/33 sha256_canonical equal git rev-parse HEAD:<path> (domain git_blob_id); E7 description explicitly covers 'single declared identity domain' and discloses that platform-dependent worktree hashes are intentionally not declared - the cleanest of the two remedies T1R-02 allowed.

A-common is fully satisfied: declared hashes equal actual 33/33, paths are inside the allowed roots, no out-of-boundary write (commit c67d4f1be wrote exactly the 7 run files), unknowns listed explicitly in receipt.unresolved.

All 16 cases' factual assertions verify true against their cited or corroborating sources; no fabrication, no overstatement, no private payload copied (max 171 chars), no sealed marking, no double group attribution.

Minimal-change discipline held: after stripping v2's worktree keys, 15/16 incidents are field-identical to v3; coverage_matrix and source_groups are equivalent except generated_at_utc/run_id/schema. The sole substantive delta (INC-10's canonical re-pin) was forced by an external file overwrite and is required to keep the hash gate true.

Every 'do not change' item from T1R-02 is preserved: six-family coverage, three expected_category values, the 24/24/24 build-plan labelling, no-sealed marking, B0 zero calls, and write-scope compliance all recomputed clean.
Regression is clean: INC-11, INC-12, INC-13, CTRL-01 key strings and INC-06's three-source corroboration all still hold against their true sources.
justification.handoff_to_closer: MANDATORY before this case set calibrates the evidence-integrity / raw-record-integrity hard gates - fix F12: (1) re-point T1-INC-10's reviews/T1R-02/REVIEW.md reference to a stable true-source for the 6/13/three-domain sub-claim (e.g. runs/T-1/20261014T085638Z_ba9297ac/receipt.json C11_authority_three_domain, or runs/T-1/20261014T085957Z_4e1698d1/summary.md), OR restore/relocate the overwritten T-1 review and re-pin; (2) verify the authorization for the closer's overwrite of the tracked T-1 review at commit b75a083dc (CLAUDE.md 'Ask first: deleting or renaming tracked historical material'). F12 is the materialization of the F10 risk T1R-02 already assigned to the closer.
minimal_fix_set: F12 (mandatory, closer): repair INC-10's evidence pointer / the T1R-02 overwrite of the T-1 review before hard-gate calibration
Optional F13: drop 'worktree hash' from E7.method (or annotate it computed-not-declared) so method matches the now-undeclared worktree dimension
Optional F14: log a t1v3/F9 event in events.jsonl, unify the supersedes chain to v2 across coverage_matrix/events, and decide the artifacts_manifest schema version per its own versioning axis
justification.not_rejected_because: Not a fabrication, factual mis-attribution, overstatement or boundary case. The residual defect that drove T1R-02's rejection (a declared-hash mismatch in an unlabelled domain) is fully eliminated - sha256_worktree is gone and the canonical domain is 33/33 reproducible. INC-10's assertions are true and independently documented; its one degraded pointer is externally caused (the closer's overwrite of the T-1 review) and is a hygiene issue, not a false claim. A-common passes, the fact layer closes on 16/16, and every 'do not change' item is intact. The v3 micro-run did exactly its mandate, minimally and correctly.
justification.preserve_unchanged: Six-family coverage, three expected_category values, the 24/24/24 build-plan labelling, no-sealed marking, B0 declaration, write-scope compliance, the closed F9 residual (sha256_worktree must remain absent; refs must keep the single git_blob_id declared domain), and every verified regression result must not be altered; subsequent micro-runs must not reintroduce a second hash domain or revert INC-11/12/13/CTRL-01/INC-06 evidence pointers.
justification.summary: The T1R-02 residual rework succeeded cleanly: the sha256_worktree field is removed entirely (0 occurrences), source_refs carry exactly the five required keys, 33/33 canonical git_blob_id digests recompute against git rev-parse HEAD:<path>, and E7 covers the single declared identity domain. A-common passes 33/33, all 16 cases verify factually true, no fabrication/overstatement/boundary violation, all 'do not change' items preserved, and the directed regression is clean. The proposal is ACCEPTED, conditioned on the closer repairing one mandatory advisory (F12): INC-10's citation of reviews/T1R-02/REVIEW.md became self-referential after the closer overwrote the T-1 review there (the F10 collision) - the claims are true and documented in runs/T-1/*, but the pointer must be repaired before this case set calibrates the hard gates. F13/F14 are low-severity hygiene.
justification.why_not_pending_human_review: The core F12 remedy (re-pointing INC-10 to runs/T-1/* true sources) is record-layer and within the artifact's own edit scope; only restoring the overwritten T-1 review touches git/historical material, and that is a closer/authorization handoff (the F10 item T1R-02 already routed to the closer), not a substantive question about the v3 package. Per the T0R-01/T1R-01/T1R-02 disposition precedent that record-layer defects do not escalate to a human gate, the proposal is ACCEPTED rather than PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW.
